title: Remapping deletion changes the reference-map count immediately
summary: All three null-producing remaps immediately report an empty singleton map. In a one-segment map with a second key, the count now agrees with the surviving iterator entry.

change.description: Removing a live entry by returning null from compute, computeIfPresent or merge now updates the count before the operation returns.

notes: The caller keeps the entry objects reachable and reads size and emptiness before any lookup or purge. Replacing the value kept size one.
The reported 6.2.13 release reproduced the stale singleton and size-two survivor counts. The same caller on 7.1.0 reproduced all three merged outcomes.
